about: Kapanol was supplied twice with no prescription laxative nearby, and the patient reports regular use for pain despite an ineffective non-prescription laxative.
A possible finding remains because the tablets contain 15 mg of codeine per unit, there is no prescription laxative nearby, and regular use and non-prescription laxative use are unknown.
The earlier Aspalgin contains 8 mg of codeine per tablet, and both later Durotram XR supplies have prescribed glycerol for constipation within the two-month window.
